=== PHONE DEEP-DIVE (live + JS source, verified) ===
ARCHITECTURE: phone = purchased item (400, inventory.phone), sidebar button gated isPurchased('phone'). Opens a MODAL (#phone dialog), NOT passage nav. UI = status bar (Day+Time) + app grid + Turn off. Apps render conditionally in PhoneHome (<<if account>>/<<if isQuestActive>>) so the launcher GROWS with progression. Each app is backed by its own JS service (service-layer architecture): PhoneService, InstafameService, NakedLifeService, FastJobsService, PornCenterService, BankService, StatsService, QuestService. 111 JS modules total, all TS-compiled classes.

DEFAULT apps: Messages, Quests, Fast Jobs, Statistics, Bank. CONDITIONAL: Instafame (needs account via quest), Naked Life (account), PornCenter (account).

=== CHAT SYSTEM (Messages) — the core ===
Data model (PhoneService): player.phone.threads[] each = {id,name,messages:[entryId],sentActions:[{id,speakerId,text,dayUsed,imagePath,timestamp}],actionUsageDays:{actionId:dayNum},hasUnread}. selectedThread = open thread id.
Message entryId = templateId::timestamp::rand (instanced — same template can recur). RenderPhoneMessage wikis <<{templateId}Message>> — so each message BODY is an authored SugarCube widget. Thread metadata catalog = MESSAGE_THREADS {JamalPoolParty->Jamal, VeronicaCostumeParty->Veronica, MarcusDate->Marcus}.
UI flow: Inbox (thread list, each btn label '<name> - N unread messages'/'Read') -> open thread -> TIMELINE (messages+sentActions merged, sorted by timestamp) -> 'Quick actions' reply buttons at bottom.
REPLIES: sending an action pushes player msg + auto-pushes NPC reply from THREAD_ACTION_REPLIES[threadId][actionId] (per-NPC custom lines, with _default fallback). e.g. Jamal sendSelfie -> 'Damn, you look cute as hell in that pic.'
GATING (verified live): two independent gates per action — (1) LOCKED: PHOTO_ACTIONS minCorruption (sendSelfie none, sendLewd>=3 'not corrupted enough', sendNude>=4) -> 🔒+lockedNote. (2) DISABLED: actionUsageDays[id]==currentDay -> ✦ 'Available tomorrow' DAILY COOLDOWN (one send per action per day; retry -> 'You already used this action today'). Verified: corr0 selfie ok / lewd+nude 🔒; after send selfie -> disabled; corr->4 -> lewd+nude unlock.
THREAD_ACTIONS are GLOBAL (sendSelfie/sendLewd/sendNude apply to every thread) — photo content is shared, only the reply text is per-NPC. So the chat is a PHOTO-SHARING loop (selfie/lewd/nude) gated by corruption + daily cadence, not free-text branching.
TWO chat generations coexist: NEW service-thread system (above) + OLD inline invitation widget (InvitationMessage in PhoneMessages, uses player.phone.messageStates[key]='accepted'/'declined', Accept/Decline links embedded IN the message body). Jamal thread shows both at once: invitation links inside the bubble + photo quick-actions below.

=== OTHER PHONE APPS ===
Instafame: social media. account+name+followers+likes. Take selfie / lewd selfie (corr>=3) -> followers. DMs from men (Jim/Richard/Edward) are QUEST DISPATCHERS (Jim->Pornstar quest, unlocks filmStudio at corr>=4).
Naked Life: exhibitionist forum. rank (Newbie/Exhibitionist/Shameless/Legend) + exp + challenges (accept/complete -> XP -> rank up). Tabbed by rank.
Fast Jobs: money grind. 4 jobs (DogWalking 45/Afternoon, HouseCleaning 75/Morning, BabySitting 110/Afternoon, ElderlyCare 110/Morning), repeatable, day-period-gated, give income + xp. Enter location to perform.
PornCenter: porn-career app. account + sites[] (ZVideos etc, by genre). 
Bank / Statistics / Quests: utility apps (BankService/StatsService/QuestService).
xCamService exists = webcam (the Laptop activity).
GALLERY MODE: galleryMode() pins getCorruptionLevel->4, getArousal->10, getExb->99, and skips mutators (FinishFastJob/AddTime/CompleteNakedLifeChallenge). Confirms doc40 E-GALLERY freeze design.
DESIGN PHILOSOPHY: phone = a second hub (alongside the world map). It packages all the SOLO/remote progression loops (earn money, grow social fame, message NPCs photos, exhibitionist challenges, porn career) behind one diegetic device, each as an isolated service, each gated by corruption tier + daily cadence + quest unlocks. It is the 'menu of repeatable remote activities' counterpart to the location hubs' in-person activities.
